work_ledger.interpretation: The original attempt global FLOPs are missing and are never imputed. Retained row-local counters are incomplete observed subsets. Recovery run work and recovery qualification work are separately itemized; their sum is the complete known recovery cost. Never add row-local counters to these global ledgers. Known observed update attempts plus the bounded unknown original attempts are not a measured FLOP total.

logical_vs_observed_updates.interpretation: Unknown range is a count bound after the last persisted progress; it is not an inclusive step-index interval.

work_ledger.original_attempt_global_work: MISSING; no original global execution-work receipt

original_process_loss.termination_cause: unknown; execution transport disconnected during the attempt

work_ledger.per_run_seconds_scope: Sum of per-arm timers only; not total wall time and excludes preparation/qualification not attached to arms.

preparation_forward_calls_reconstructed.basis: fixed warm/train/validation schedule; this is a call count, not a FLOP estimate

prior_failure_separate_not_in_any_total.error: optimizer got an empty parameter list

retained_row_local_work_counters_not_add.interpretation: This sum includes overlapping local counters across rows and phases; it is diagnostic only, not an attempt-global total.
